description: Use this when an adult asks how their waist measurement compares with the suggested range for fitness, such as "is 36 inch waist too big for a man", "waist 88 cm woman", "waist to height ratio 92 cm 170 cm" or "recommended waist size for Indians". Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical, treatment or medication questions.

height_ft.description: Height feet part, if not using centimetres

height_in.description: Height inches part, used with height_ft

sex.description: Sex, since the suggested ranges differ

waist_cm.description: Waist in centimetres, measured at the belly button after breathing out

waist_in.description: Waist in inches, if not using centimetres

name: waist_check
title: Waist size check
